metadata.title: Gauge theory on Cohomogeneity One Spin(7)-Manifolds from Aloff--Wallach Spaces
metadata.abstract: We begin a systematic study of $\mathrm{Spin}(7)$-instantons on complete non-compact cohomogeneity one $\mathrm{Spin}(7)$-manifolds with Aloff--Wallach spaces $N_{k,l}=\mathrm{SU}(3)/\mathrm{U}(1)_{k,l}$ as principal orbits. We provide a complete classification of admissible principal $\mathrm{U}(1)$- and $\mathrm{SO}(3)$-bundles and smooth bounded solutions to the $\mathrm{Spin}(7)$-instanton equation on them. We study bubbling phenomena for the constructed $\mathrm{Spin}(7)$-instantons and discuss the compactification of the moduli space of $\mathrm{Spin}(7)$-instantons in both the ALC and AC settings.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 特殊 holonomy 上的瞬子构造
analysis.workSummary: 在以 Aloff–Wallach 空间为主轨道的完备非紧余齐性一 Spin(7) 流形上，分类允许的 U(1)、SO(3) 主丛及其光滑有界瞬子解，并研究 AC、ALC 情形的冒泡和模空间紧化。
techniques: 余齐性一 Spin(7) 方程
analysis.breakthrough: 提供非紧特殊 holonomy 规范理论的系统模型族。
analysis.limitations: 需核对分类中对称性和 admissible 的准确范围，不能直接称为全部任意 Spin(7) 流形上的瞬子分类。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
